description:
Desde 1948, a Andrade Gutierrez vem ajudando a construir e a desenvolver o Brasil. Desde então, a empresa tem participado de algumas das obras mais importantes da história de nosso país. A Andrade Gutierrez se destaca como uma das maiores empresas de engenharia da América Latina e nossa trajetória tem sido marcada pela busca por novas oportunidades e grandes desafios.
Nosso desenvolvimento acontece de forma sustentável e está apoiado em pilares como qualidade, responsabilidade socioambiental e segurança no trabalho. Nossas unidades de engenharia e construção são focadas em projetos de Infraestrutura, Energia, Mobilidade e Indústria, com ênfase na excelência operacional.
Se você é focado em processos, é flexível e se adapta às mudanças, e anseia por trabalhar em uma multinacional em expansão, aqui é o seu lugar
Na Andrade Gutierrez todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, independente de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia ou deficiência.

Responsável pela Coordenação Técnica multidisciplinar (Processo, Segurança, Mecânica, Tubulação, Elétrica, Instrumentação, Automação e Civil/Metálica) nas fases de Projeto Básico e Detalhado no segmento de Óleo & Gás, garantindo conformidade com as normas do cliente.

Prover suporte técnico ao grupo de qualidade, comissionamento, construção e montagem durante a obra.

title: Product Ops Sênior
description:
Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação
Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente de Soluções para a Prática Médica para trabalhar de forma híbrida em SP/BH/RJ.
Ao assumir o cargo de Agile Master Sênior na Afya, seu objetivo principal será atuar facilitando práticas ágeis, removendo impedimentos, promovendo colaboração e apoiando a evolução cultural, utilizando métricas e ferramentas para garantir alinhamento e entrega contínua de valor.
Você atuará na área de Product Ops dentro da diretoria de Produto e fará parte de uma equipe multidisciplinar, relacionando-se no dia a dia com pessoas de times como Produto,Tecnologia, Design, Dados, Marketing, CX e time B2B.
Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
COMO VOCÊ VAI TRANSFORMAR A SAÚDE NO DIA A DIA:
Implementar e evoluir sistemas de métricas de fluxo (cycle time, throughput, WIP, flow efficiency) com base no Kanban Method.
Aplicar estatística, teoria de filas e simulações Monte Carlo para análises preditivas e decisões baseadas em dados.
Integrar métricas de produto (discovery e outcome) às métricas de fluxo para avaliar valor entregue.
Conduzir mapeamentos de value stream e jornadas de usuários, identificando gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria.
Colaborar com trios de produto (PM, Design, Tech Lead) e lideranças para alinhar operações à estratégia.
Facilitar discussões sobre outcomes versus outputs, promovendo mentalidade orientada a valor.
Projetar e implementar automações de workflows e integrações entre ferramentas (n8n, Jira, Confluence, Rovo AI, MCP Servers, Microsoft Automations).
Eliminar trabalho manual e criar sistemas self-service.
Aplicar IA para otimização de fluxo e melhoria de processos.
Disseminar práticas de flow management em áreas além de produto.
Garantir alinhamento estratégico e fluxo de informação entre níveis organizacionais (Flight Levels).
Facilitar cadências e práticas que promovam transparência, inspeção e adaptação.
Apoiar evolução da maturidade organizacional em gestão de fluxo (Kanban Maturity Model).
Requisitos e qualificações
O QUE BUSCAMOS (mas não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos):
Experiência com gestão de produtos digitais e práticas de flow management.
Profundo conhecimento em Kanban Method, métricas de fluxo e previsibilidade (cycle time, throughput, Monte Carlo).
Familiaridade com discovery contínua (continuous discovery habits, opportunity solution trees).
Conhecimento aplicado de Product Operating Model e Product Operations.
Experiência com automação de workflows e integrações.
Compreensão de estatística básica, teoria de filas e análise de dados.
Conhecimento de frameworks: Flight Levels, Team Topologies, Cynefin, OKRs.

title: Volunteer System Coordinator
description:
Department: Workforce, People & Culture
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
Reporting to the Volunteer Systems Manager, the Volunteer Systems Coordinator will actively participate in the design, development, and implementation of the Volunteer Management System for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027. The successful candidate must demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and a strong ability to solve complex problems, particularly in the context of volunteerism and database management systems. In addition to managing system integrations that are crucial for an efficient volunteer journey, the role requires collaboration across the Volunteer department to ensure that the technology platforms meet contractual requirements and support critical business processes effectively.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Support the Volunteer Systems Manager in ensuring all technical requirements are captured, documented, and addressed within the Volunteer Management System.
Assist in defining and refining volunteer journey requirements across all modules of the volunteer management system, including Recruitment, Assignments, Scheduling, Rostering, Training, Accreditation and Uniform Distribution, and tournament Operations.
Support with the development and defining the integration matrix mapping necessary for all relevant systems, ensuring seamless connectivity and data flow across platforms.
Support the preparation and delivery of system training materials and assist with training sessions for system user.s. This involves prioritizing user requests, managing deadlines, and defining essential system reports to support operational needs.
Coordinate the development and delivery of the system to meet all required specifications. Provide ongoing problem resolution and support following the go-live date to ensure seamless system performance.
Contribute innovative ideas to improve and optimize system workflows.
Work in close collaboration with internal FIFA Functional Areas and Host Cities to help ensure the successful development, implementation and management of the Volunteer Management System.
Identify and report system-related issues and diligently follow up to ensure their resolution or escalate as necessary to mitigate potential impacts.
Support with planning and delivery for the Official Draw, Playoffs and other readiness workshops.
Responsibilities of the role will likely evolve during the lifespan of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027, and the successful candidate should be supportive and flexible to additional requirements.
YOUR PROFILE
Minimum 5 years of experience in large-scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
Desired - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science or related field.
Efficient communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to follow governance processes, manage change requests, and escalate issues appropriately.
Adaptable to work across multiple teams, locations, and time zones.
Ability to balance priorities whilst working in a fast-moving progressive environment.
Strong team player, adaptable to working under tight timelines, and ready to step in wherever needed to drive success, with a commitment to delivering results without compromising quality.
Exceptional attention to detail.
Strong proficiency in using technology, including the Office 365 suite and industry-specific software.
Experienced in working with various Event Management Systems and/or Volunteer Management Systems.
Right to work in Brazil.
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
Start date: 06 April (tentative or to be agreed)

title: Senior Recruiter – Tech
description:
About Clera
Clera is rethinking how top talent finds their next opportunity. We're backed by leading U.S. investors and already work with some of the most respected startups in AI, including Mintlify, Luminai, and Windsurf.
Our AI Talent Agent sits at the center of how candidates get matched, qualified, and introduced to world-class companies.
We're now looking for a Senior Recruiter to help us scale our U.S. searches. This is a high-impact role where you combine your recruiting expertise with a next-generation AI workflow and directly shape how modern recruiting works.

Own high-impact, end-to-end searches for U.S.-based roles using Clera's AI platform. You'll be the strategic recruiting partner for our clients: running full cycles, advising hiring managers, and using data and judgment to drive great hires.

Experience recruiting across multiple functions (engineering, sales, operations, G&A).

Success managing multiple searches and high-volume pipelines in parallel.

title: Consultor de Vendas
description:
Seu DNA é Tech e seu talento é comercial? Venha ser um Consultor de Soluções em Tecnologia na SDE Distribuidora
Na SDE Distribuidora, buscamos profissionais que vão além da venda: procuramos profissionais que transformam conhecimento técnico em soluções inteligentes. Se você respira tecnologia, tem experiência em campo e o brilho nos olhos para prospectar e construir parcerias duradouras, seu lugar é com a gente.
Nosso Consultor de Soluções em Tecnologia é o profissional estratégico que conecta a tecnologia às necessidades reais de nossos clientes. Sua missão vai além da venda de produtos, transformando o conhecimento técnico em soluções inovadoras e personalizadas em segurança eletrônica, redes, comunicação e energia. Você será o elo que impulsiona o crescimento mútuo e solidifica parcerias, contribuindo ativamente para a excelência da SDE no mercado.
PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES
Diagnosticar e propor soluções técnicas: Entender a fundo as necessidades dos clientes para desenhar e apresentar soluções completas e integradas em nosso portfólio (segurança eletrônica, redes, comunicação e energia), realizando demonstrações e prestando consultoria especializada.
Gerenciar e expandir carteira de clientes: Atuar de forma proativa no desenvolvimento e manutenção de um relacionamento próximo com a carteira, identificando novas oportunidades e reativando clientes inativos através de uma abordagem técnica e assertiva.
Elaborar e negociar propostas de valor: Criar propostas comerciais e orçamentos detalhados e tecnicamente consistentes, negociando termos que gerem valor para o cliente e para a SDE, e otimizando o processo de vendas.
Manter-se atualizado e compartilhar conhecimento: Buscar constante aprimoramento sobre as tendências do mercado de tecnologia, produtos e normas técnicas, participando de treinamentos e certificações, e compartilhando esse conhecimento com a equipe e clientes.
Representar a SDE como referência técnica: Fortalecer a imagem da SDE em eventos do setor e assegurar a satisfação do cliente no pós-venda, buscando oportunidades de cross-selling e up-selling.
REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS:
Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas ou técnicas no setor de tecnologia (distribuição, integração, instalação ou fabricantes de hardware/software).
Conhecimento técnico aprofundado em pelo menos uma das áreas de atuação da SDE:
Segurança Eletrônica: CFTV (analógico/IP), controle de acesso (biometria, RFID), alarmes, sistemas de monitoramento.
Redes e Comunicação: Redes estruturadas (cabeamento, switches, roteadores), Wi-Fi, PABX IP.
Energia: Noções de energia solar fotovoltaica, no-breaks, estabilizadores, sistemas de alimentação ininterrupta.
Habilidade para interpretar projetos técnicos e diagramas.
Experiência com CRM ou ferramentas de gestão de vendas.
REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS:
Soft Skills:
Curiosidade e Aprendizagem Contínua: Paixão por tecnologia e por se manter atualizado em um mercado dinâmico.
Pensamento Analítico: Habilidade para identificar problemas, analisar dados e propor soluções eficazes.
Comunicação Assertiva e Didática: Capacidade de explicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara para diferentes públicos.
Proatividade e Autonomia: Iniciativa para buscar novas oportunidades e gerenciar sua carteira de forma independente.
Orientação para Resultados e Foco no Cliente: Impulso para superar metas, sempre com o cliente no centro das decisões.
Inteligência Emocional: Para lidar com desafios, negociações e construir relacionamentos.
Hard Skills Complementares:
Certificações técnicas de fabricantes relevantes (ex: CFTV IP, redes Cisco/Ubiquiti, etc.).
Conhecimento em gestão de projetos.
FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA:
Formação Acadêmica: Superior completo ou em andamento em cursos como Engenharia (Elétrica, Eletrônica, Telecomunicações, Controle e Automação), Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, ou áreas afins.
Certificações: Certificações técnicas na área de segurança eletrônica, redes, ou energia solar serão consideradas um diferencial.
Experiência Profissional
Vendas técnicas ou consultivas em empresas de distribuição ou integração de tecnologia.
Instalação ou suporte técnico avançado em sistemas de segurança eletrônica, redes ou energia, com forte interface com clientes e/ou vendas.
Pré-vendas técnicas ou engenharia de soluções.
Experiência prévia com gestão de carteira de clientes B2B.
Se você se identifica com esse perfil e busca um desafio onde sua expertise técnica e comercial farão a diferença, candidate-se agora

title: Oficial Eletricista
description:
Executar serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva de INSTALAÇÕES, inspecionando sistemas elétricos, efetuando a troca de lâmpadas, luminárias e reatores, verificando o estado de interruptores, tomadas e condutores, passando cabos por conduletes, instalando eletrocalhas, eletrodutos e dutos subterrâneos e realizando outras tarefas, visando o atendimento às necessidades do Contrato. Executar a manutenção elétrica preventiva e corretiva de MÁQUINAS E EQUIPAMENTOS (Aparelhos e equipamentos hospitalares, Back Lights, Postes de Iluminação, Boilers, Bombas hidráulicas, Tele Tubos, máquinas de lavar louça, cafeteiras, liquidificadores, fornos, etc. ), lubrificando peças e trocando circuitos, comandos e motores, a fim de possibilitar o pleno funcionamento da infra-estrutura do Contrato. Executar a manutenção preventiva de QUADROS ELÉTRICOS de BAIXA Tensão, isolando ferramentas, reapertando e trocando disjuntores e borneiras de circuitos, instalando contactores, verificando condições de fios e cabos, efetuando medições de tensão e corrente elétrica através de aparelho Multiteste, limpando componentes com a utilização de produtos químicos específicos e realizando outras atividades, visando o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos, instalações e infra-estrutura do Contrato. Realizar operações em LINHAS DE ALTA TENSÃO no caso de queda de energia e mediante autorização da Light, efetuando manobras e transferências de ramais de acordo com os equipamentos e procedimentos de segurança requeridos, a fim de possibilitar a religação da força necessária ao atendimento das necessidades do Contrato. Executar a manutenção preventiva de NO BREAK, efetuando a leitura de parâmetros e a medição de corrente elétrica, reapertando peças, limpando componentes e trocando baterias, a fim de manter as condições de operacionalidade requeridas. Executar a manutenção preventiva de SUBESTAÇÕES, limpando componentes, reapertando e lubrificando peças, medindo a voltagem de baterias, trocando fusíveis, verificando o funcionamento de quadro de capacitores, nível de óleo combustível e lubrificante de motores e estado de conservação de correias e mangueiras, bem como, inspecionando ruídos, aquecimentos e outras anormalidades, a fim de propiciar o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos e infra-estrutura do Contrato. Operar Subestações no caso de falta de energia elétrica, acompanhando a ligação automática do equipamento e desligando o Gerador no restabelecimento da força, visando o pleno fornecimento de energia para máquinas e instalações do Contrato. Efetuar a manutenção preventiva de TRANSFORMADORES, reapertando e lubrificando peças. Efetuar a leitura de plantas, desenhos e diagramas elétricos. Emitir formulário específico (Laudo), detalhando tipos de problemas, setores, equipamentos e outras informações referentes aos serviços executados, para fins de controle e informação à Chefia. Efetuar anotações em Livro de Ocorrências, indicando os eventos ocorridos, serviços executados, horários, datas e outras informações pertinentes, a fim de possibilitar o controle dos serviços de manutenção. Atuar em outras especialidades de manutenção elétrica conforme a necessidade. Orientar os demais profissionais da equipe, dirimindo dúvidas e indicando procedimentos, a fim de agilizar os trabalhos de manutenção.

title: Enfermeiro(a) - Centro Cirúrgico - Barra D'Or
description:
Detalhes da vaga


Requisitos:

- Formação: Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.

- Registro no COREN RJ ativo e em regularidade.

- Experiência nas atividades do Centro Cirúrgico.

Atividades:

- Coordenar a equipe de Técnicos de Enfermagem do Centro Cirúrgico, orientando-os na execução das atividades diárias da área, a fim de garantir a aplicação da técnica correta a cada patologia, em conformidade com as normas estabelecidas pela Unidade, bem como prover assistência adequada aos pacientes sob seus cuidados.

- Realizar a dupla checagem de reservas de sangue, patologia, Unidades Fechadas, entre outros itens todos os procedimentos invasivos de maior complexidade nos pacientes, tais como: cateterismo vesical, sonda nasogástrica ou nasoentérica, entre outros, aplicando técnicas específicas e utilizando os EPIs recomendados, afim de garantir a aplicação do procedimento definidos conforme normas e regras da Unidade.

- Recepcionar o paciente na chegada ao centro cirúrgico, realizando o check list do paciente (certificar-se da entrega do prontuário, pulseira de identificação, marcação de lateralidade, entre outros, bem como acompanhando os mesmos até a sala de cirurgias e realizando juntamente com a equipe médica, um novo check list.

- Colaborar com o anestesista durante o ato anestésico, auxiliando-o durante a intubação, bem como realizar sondagem vesical, caso solicitado pelo Médico.

- Confirmar se os materiais consignados, solicitados pelos Médicos, encontram disponíveis no Arsenal do Centro Cirúrgico, conforme planejamento previsto.

- Participar dos treinamentos técnicos definidos/recomendados pelo gestor da área, visando garantir o desenvolvimento técnico-profissional da equipe e a qualidade da assistência prestada pela Unidade.

- Manter registro no Livro de Ordens e Ocorrências, de todos os procedimentos ocorridos durante seu plantão, garantir a continuidade da assistência junto responsável pelo próximo plantão.

- Efetuar a conferência diária dos desfibriladores, dos lacres do carro de parada e das maletas de intubações e transporte, garantindo o perfeito estado de funcionamento e prontidão dos mesmos.

- Garantir que a quantidade de Técnicos de Enfermagem no plantão seja suficiente para a prestação do serviço com a qualidade estabelecidas nas normas e padrões da Unidade, bem como reportando ao Superior imediato as necessidades de remanejamento de pessoal junto as demais áreas."

- Disponibilidade para treinamento.

title: Data Analyst
description:
About Match Affinity
Match Affinity is a division of Match Group that drives the fastest growing dating apps. Every month, millions of users come to our apps, like BLK and Chispa, to find matches and make great connections.
The Role
As a Data Analyst on our Product Analytics Team, you'll use data to understand our users -- what they need, what they do, how to retain them, and ultimately how to help them find the best dates.  Then you will partner with cross-functional teams to provide long-term strategic insights for our products.  You will also support business trends/forecasting and model the financial impact of new product ideas.

What You'll Do

  • A strong knowledge querying massive and complex datasets, analyzing, and driving key and actionable insights
  • Working with other cross-functional teams like Finance, CRM, Engineering and Business Intelligence; proactively engage other teams to identify and drive better user experience
  • Providing internal consulting to product management, marketing, finance, and CRM teams on A/B tests as they move initiatives from concept to market
  • Presenting technical content across business stakeholders
  • Working as the product owner of revenue and retention strategies for the product
  • Serving as the subject matter expert on applying various statistical methodologies towards distilling actionable insights
  • Researching issues about customer behavior/changes by analyzing relevant metrics, trends and supporting enterprise level initiatives
  • Supporting these products: Chispa, BLK, Upward, Yuzu

You might be a Match if you have:

  • 3+ years of hands on SQL (or structured data) experience along with advanced Excel Skills
  • Exposure to applied statistics (descriptive statistics, statistical testing, design of experiments, linear modeling, time series analysis etc); Python/SPSS/SAS/R experience a plus
  • Self-starter with good communications skills
  • You have experience going beyond number-crunching, reports, and dashboard creation -- you are able to understand the business impact of the data and make recommendations based on your findings
  • Excellent problem solving skills
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics,Economics, Computer Science, Engineering related field, Marketing, or MBA with quantitative focus
  • Experience in product analytics supporting digital applications including mobile apps & consumer internet is preferred
  • Fluent English is required.

Import to know:

  • As a global company operating across different time zones, flexibility in working hours will be important for this role.

  • Please submit your CV in English

title: Quantitative Project Manager
description:
Company Description

M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we've seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Quantitative Project Manager at M3 Global Research.

About the Business Unit:

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.

Job Description

The Mission:

The mission of the Quantitative Project Manager is to be a communication and relationship liaison between M3, our clients, and other teams involved in the project's completion. You will directly manage all aspects of each project on time and within budget. This is the ideal role for someone who has experience in international online market research specifically focused on healthcare, sampling, survey recruitment, and collaboration with all teams involved in the project.

Duties include:

  • Manage international quantitative market research projects through entire project life cycle including all aspects of managing clients, partners, healthcare professional sample, and consumer sample.
  • Work directly with various teams to setup and test survey links and redirects, prepare and send sample, conduct quality/audit checks, managing respondent inquiries and honorarium and all other components of online research.
  • Coordinate and lead project kickoff meetings for all assigned studies to ensure all involved parties understand project specifications, client needs, timelines, and responsibilities.
  • Manage and leverage relationships with vendors to facilitate accurate and timely deliverables, communications, and issue resolution.
  • Monitor productivity and quality of data collection to produce regular updates and progress reports on project status.
  • Manage study profitability by monitoring and accounting for all project costs affecting the budget.
  • Partner with sales team members and operations staff to address issues and/or make recommendations to improve performance on research studies.
  • Work independently to support international teams outside of normal US business hours.

Esta vaga contempla as unidades localizadas na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana.

Aqui no Elite, valorizamos e incentivamos a diversidade. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade, origem, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica. Acreditamos que times diversos constroem uma educação ainda mais transformadora.

Presentes em Belo Horizonte, Distrito Federal, Goiás, Mato Grosso do Sul, Paraná, Santa Catarina, São Paulo e Rio de Janeiro, há 20 anos, somos a escola responsável por transformar vidas por meio da educação. Para alcançarmos o nosso objetivo, contamos com um time apaixonado pelo poder transformador da educação e que entende o que é ser escola hoje, se preocupando, em primeiro lugar, com os alunos. Aqui você vai encontrar:

AMOR

Somos movidos pelo amor. A vitória de cada aluno é a vitória de todos: escola, aluno e família.

GARRA

Lutamos com persistência, todos os dias e até o fim, para que o nosso aluno possa ir além. Sabemos que é o esforço dele que o faz crescer.

FOCO

Sabemos aonde queremos chegar e temos determinação e disciplina para chegar lá.

MÉRITO

Valorizamos cada um conforme seu esforço e resultado. Vitória e mérito andam sempre juntos.

Se você sonha em trabalhar transformando vidas e reescrevendo histórias, o seu lugar é no Elite.

title: Analista de Cobrança
description:
Buscamos um(a) Analista em Cobrança com perfil jurídico e experiência em Recuperação Judicial e Falência. Essa posição terá papel estratégico na recuperação de créditos, atuando tanto na cobrança administrativa quanto no suporte inicial às cobranças judiciais, com foco em empresas em situação de estresse financeiro ou em processos de recuperação judicial. O(a) profissional será fundamental para reforçar a segurança jurídica e otimizar os resultados da companhia em cenários complexos de inadimplência.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Conduzir negociações de cobrança administrativa com clientes inadimplentes, propondo alternativas seguras (parcelamentos, acordos, garantias).
Elaborar notificações extrajudiciais, cartas de cobrança, contratos de confissão de dívida e aditivos com garantias reais ou fidejussórias.
Atuar na análise de contratos e identificar riscos jurídicos de clientes em situação de crise financeira.
Preparar documentação para habilitação de crédito em processos de Recuperação Judicial, Pré-Recuperação Judicial ou Falência, interagindo com escritórios parceiros e administradores judiciais.
Apoiar a área jurídica na estruturação de ações de cobrança, execuções, monitórias e incidentes processuais.
Monitorar prazos legais, decisões judiciais e eventos relevantes em processos de clientes estratégicos.
Acompanhar indicadores de recuperação e propor estratégias específicas para carteiras em risco de insolvência.
Contribuir com melhorias em políticas de crédito e cobrança, alinhadas à legislação e ao contexto do setor de infraestrutura.
Requisitos e qualificações
Formação superior em Direito (OAB ativa);
Desejável pós-graduação em Direito Empresarial, Recuperação Judicial ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência em cobrança administrativa e judicial, prefrencialmente em empresas ou escritórios com foco em direito empresarial, contencioso cível e recuperação jurídica/falência;
Necessário conhecimento em Direito Civil, Empresarial e Processual Civil;
Necessário conhecimento em setruturação de garantias reais e fidejussórias (penhor, alienação fiduciária, cessão de recebíveis);
Necessário conhecimento em habilitação e acompanhamento de créditos em processos judiciais;
Necessário conhecimento em elaboração de notificações extrajudiciais, contratos de confissão de dívida e instrumentos de cobrança;
Desejável conhecimento em sistemas de gestão.

Quer trabalhar na maior empresa de bikes elétricas do Brasil?
Nascemos em 2010, no Rio de Janeiro.
A nossa missão desde então é fazer com que as pessoas reflitam sobre os seus hábitos.
E não apenas os hábitos relacionados à mobilidade urbana.
Queremos que as pessoas olhem mais ao seu redor.
Como você leva a sua vida?
Qual é a sua relação com a natureza, com o tempo, com o seu trabalho, família e amigos?
A nossa marca não é apenas sobre bicicletas elétricas.
A Lev é sobre escolhas, como escolher o caminho mais bonito em vez do mais rápido.

title: Manager, Volunteer System
description:
Department: Events & Entertainment
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.
The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.
We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.
Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
Act as the volunteer department's main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in-line with FIFA's data protection standards.
Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision-making.
Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct "Train-the-Trainer" sessions for system users.
Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost-effective delivery methods.
Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
Ensure a structured systems close-out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
Represent the Volunteer team in cross-functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.
YOUR PROFILE
Minimum 5 years of experience in large-scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
Education: Master's in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
Proven experience managing large-scale technology or systems implementation projects.
Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
High cultural awareness with experience in multi-stakeholder and multicultural environments.
Training delivery experience a plus
Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
Team player with internal and external stakeholders
Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast-paced environment.
Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community-building, sport, and service.
Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
Right to work in Brazil.
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence
description:
Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence & C4 (RiC4)


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence & C4 (RiC4) is responsible for leading the structured identification, assessment, monitoring and mitigation of safety and security risks for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027. The role establishes and manages the tournament-wide risk management framework, supports intelligence coordination and contributes to the development and implementation of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications and Computers) governance structure. The position ensures that risk-informed decision-making underpins all safety and security planning and operational activities across official tournament sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and implement a formal risk and threat identification, assessment and prioritisation process for all official tournament sites and activities
  • Develop, maintain and continuously update the tournament-wide security risk register, ensuring risks are tracked, assessed and mitigated throughout all phases of the event
  • Conduct risk assessment analyses for host cities, stadiums, non-competition sites as well as other specific ancillary events, matches, sites or activities, and develop corresponding risk treatment action plans
  • Coordinate threat, intelligence and situational awareness inputs from domestic and international partners, ensuring structured analysis and dissemination
  • Continuously gather and analyse intelligence relevant to tournament operations and provide structured strategic and operational briefings to senior management and relevant functional areas
  • Support the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications & Coordination) systems, ensuring alignment with the overall FWWC operational governance framework
  • Enable effective information flow to leadership and operational teams, including leading the daily reporting rhythms and information cycles as defined in the C4i concept
  • Develop standard operating protocols for escalating, responding to and monitoring operational risks
  • Assist in determining appropriate security assets and protective measures required to safeguard official sites and assets
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with domestic and, where required, international intelligence agencies and/or with the relevant FA Manager (Public Security) to support integrated security planning
  • Support and encourage the establishment of a Police Cooperation Centre (or equivalent mechanism) to enhance intelligence and information sharing among stakeholders
  • Monitor compliance with statutory, regulatory and organisational instruments relevant to risk management and security operations
  • Support and advise on background check protocols and related risk considerations in coordination with the Accreditation & Access functions

YOUR PROFILE


Education

  • University degree in security management, risk management, criminology, intelligence studies, public safety or a related field

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in risk management, intelligence coordination or security analysis, preferably within major events, public safety agencies or multi-agency environments
  • Proven experience in developing and managing risk registers and structured risk assessment frameworks
  • Experience working with law enforcement, intelligence services or governmental security bodies in Brazil
  • Familiarity with command and control structures and operational coordination models

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to synthesise complex information into actionable insights
  • High attention to detail and structured documentation capability
  • Ability to exercise discretion and handle sensitive information with integrity
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the preparation of strategic briefings
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple functional areas and external partners
  • Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in Portuguese

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Fluency in Portuguese (spoken and written) is essential, English desirable
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

Employment Type

Fixed Term - Full Time

Location

Brazil

Workplace type

Onsite

title: Sr. Product Manager, Growth
description:
Who We Are
Mode Mobile builds apps that reward users for engaging with content, entertainment, games, and communities they love. Our portfolio includes category-defining products with millions of users globally, scaling rapidly through organic growth and strategic acquisitions.
You'll be joining NGL ("Not Gonna Lie"), one of the most viral social apps in recent years, with 144M+ monthly users across web and mobile. NGL provides a safe, curious, and authentic space for people to connect through anonymous messaging and self-expression.
Now part of Mode Mobile's portfolio, NGL is entering its next phase of explosive growth, including expanded monetization, creative experimentation, and scaled user acquisition initiatives.
The Mission
Own and scale NGL's revenue, funnels, and lifecycle growth by turning traffic into durable, monetizable user behavior. You will run growth as a system…from acquisition through retention…while protecting the viral mechanics that make NGL work.
This role is measured in metrics shipped, not features shipped.
Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success
Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard-working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.
You can read more about our team and how we work here.
The Role
This role reports directly to the General Manager - NGL and operates as the single-threaded owner of growth and monetization for the product. You will work cross-functionally with Monetization, Paid UA, Engineering, Design, and Data, and you will own feature rollout end-to-end in partnership with Engineering.
What You'll Do
Monetization Systems
You own all product-led revenue systems:
Subscription pricing, tiers, and trials
Optimize onboarding and paywall timing by traffic source
One-time purchases (reveals, hints, boosts)
Paywall timing, copy, UX, and placement
Revenue per active user (ARPDAU / ARPU)
Monetization performance by cohort (influencer, paid UA, organic)
Extensive collaboration with Monetization Team by translating revenue strategy into shipped product features
You are accountable for revenue lift without growth decay.
Organic Funnels, Influencer & Creator Funnels
NGL is creator-driven. You own:
Influencer onboarding flows
Creator-specific product surfaces and incentives
Conversion paths from influencer posts → installs → paid actions
Monetization differences by creator tier and audience quality
Feedback loops that increase creator posting frequency and retention
Partnerships source creators. Product owns the funnel.
Funnel Ownership (End-to-End)
You own the full lifecycle:
Entry (Snap, IG, TikTok, deep links)
First-session experience and activation
Message reveal mechanics and engagement triggers
Re-engagement loops (notifications, prompts, scarcity)
Conversion to paid
Design funnels that improve LTV and payback
Retention, churn reduction, and win-back flows
You are expected to know where every drop-off lives.
Experimentation & Growth Velocity
You will:
Maintain a prioritized growth experiment backlog
Run continuous A/B tests across onboarding, pricing, and UX
Test influencer-specific monetization strategies
Kill underperforming ideas quickly
Scale winners aggressively
K-Factor Optimization
Speed and learning rate matter more than perfection.
Feature Ownership & Rollout (Engineering)
You own feature execution end-to-end:
Write clear PRDs tied to growth and revenue outcomes
Prioritize engineering work based on expected impact
Partner with engineering to ship experiments quickly
Own rollout plans, gating, and ramp strategies
Monitor post-launch performance and iterate fast
You ship, measure, and refine. No throw-it-over-the-wall handoffs.
Reporting, Dashboards & GM Updates
You will:
Build and maintain clear growth dashboards
Report weekly to the NGL GM on:
Revenue performance
Funnel metrics
Experiment results
Key risks and opportunities
Provide data-backed recommendations for roadmap and spend decisions
The GM should never be surprised by the numbers
Success in This Role Means
You are directly accountable for:
Paid conversion rate
ARPU / LTV
D7 / D30 retention
Revenue by acquisition source
LTV / CAC and payback period
Experiment velocity
What You Bring to the Team
5–8+ years of experience in Growth Product, Monetization, or Lifecycle Product roles within consumer mobile apps, with clear ownership of revenue and growth outcomes
Direct ownership of core metrics such as ARPDAU, ARPU, LTV, conversion rate, retention, and payback
Experience scaling subscription and hybrid monetization models, including subscriptions and one-time purchases
Experience owning pricing strategy, paywalls, onboarding optimization, and revenue performance by cohort
Strong data fluency, including cohort analysis, funnel diagnostics, and payback modeling
Proven track record running high-velocity A/B testing and maintaining a structured experimentation backlog
Demonstrated success improving acquisition, activation, monetization, and retention through measurable experimentation
Experience partnering closely with Engineering to ship growth and monetization features end-to-end
Experience working cross-functionally with UA, Monetization, Design, and Data teams
Comfort operating as the accountable owner of revenue impact
A systems mindset that prioritizes measurable outcomes over feature output
Ability to move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information, and balance aggressive growth optimization with protecting product integrity and viral mechanics
Experience in creator-driven or social products preferred
Experience optimizing K-Factor and viral loops preferred
Experience working with Snap, Instagram, or TikTok acquisition funnels preferred
Alignment with our core values:
Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self-discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.
Action-driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.
Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.
Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.
Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.
Why Join Mode Mobile
Be part of a company where the culture is the magic. Our team consistently says the best part of Mode is the people - collaborative, humble, hungry, and genuinely invested in each other's success.
Make an impact on millions of users across a global social platform with massive scale and cultural relevance.
Work with a global, top-tier engineering team that cares deeply about craftsmanship, velocity, and helping each other win.
Shape the next stage of a high-growth social platform, entering an exciting next phase of growth, scale, and innovation.
Join a mission-driven culture where ownership is real, ideas travel fast, and your work has a visible impact.
Grow inside a fast-growing, post-acquisition business backed by strong leadership and investment in monetization, UA, and product innovation.
Work fully remote with a globally distributed team that values autonomy, trust, and transparent collaboration
We Believe in the Following Workplace Norms
Allow OKRs to Guide Us
Assume Positive Intent
Agree to Disagree & Commit
Set New Precedents
Accomplish More with Less
Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards
Speak Up
Be Resourceful
Follow the 80/20 Rule
What We Are Offering
We are a 100% remote-first, global company.
A competitive compensation package.
We offer generous perks & benefits to team members.
Participation in the Company's equity plan (for full-time team members).
We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program.
Work with energetic, passionate, and results-driven people.
Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones.
Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies.
Bonusly - We use Bonusly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment.
Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings).
Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days (for full-time team members).
If we just described you and your perfect role, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to making headway and creating success together

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment for all team members.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
The Company You'll Join


Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. 

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Team You'll Work With


You'll enter our engineering interview process as part of a pooled hiring model. We believe in hiring for Carta first, focusing on your core strengths and technical craft rather than a specific team's immediate gap. 

Staff Engineers at Carta are technical anchors for our business. You don't just own features, you take long-term accountability for the technical health and strategic direction of different domains. As you move through our process, we'll transition from the general pool to a team-matching phase. Our goal is to match your unique technical strengths, and personal career interests with our most impactful, strategic challenges. 

Strategic areas you may influence include:

  • Platform Data Ecosystem: Shaping how data flows across our entire suite of products to ensure a "single source of truth" for private market data.
  • Financial Systems Architecture: Designing resilient, scalable solutions for management fee accounting and multi-currency transactions.
  • Engineering Excellence: Defining company-wide standards that reduce operational load and improve developer velocity across dozens of teams.

The Problems You'll Solve


As a Staff Engineer, you are responsible for the long-term technical health and success of your business unit. You'll work to:

  • Navigate Ambiguity: Tackle the most complex and poorly defined problems at Carta, breaking them down into navigable paths for the rest of the organization.
  • Champion Systemic Improvement: Identify and eliminate failure patterns across multiple systems, driving architectural changes that improve scalability and reliability.
  • Bridge Technical Gaps: Use your deep understanding of cross-functional domains to align multiple teams on major technical decisions.
  • Define the AI Frontier: Lead the charge in transforming how we build by defining the context and building the rails that allow every person at Carta to leverage AI tools safely and effectively. You'll help move the organization toward a future where AI amplifies our collective engineering impact.
  • Uphold Engineering Standards: Set the vision for operational excellence and mentor senior engineers to raise the collective craft of the organization.

About You

  • The Tech Stack: You are an expert in building distributed systems. While our primary stack is Python/Django, React, and Postgres, you should be comfortable guiding technical direction across JVM languages, gRPC, and cloud-native infrastructure (AWS). 
  • Leadership: You lead through influence rather than authority, acting as a role model for constructive communication and technical discipline.
  • Vision: You don't just solve the problem in front of you; you anticipate future roadblocks and build systems that support long-term business growth.
  • Experience: We recommend 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with a track record of high-level technical leadership.

Disclosures:

  • We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email. 
  • Carta uses E-Verify in the United States for employment authorization. See the E-Verify and Department of Justice websites for more details.
  • For information on our data privacy policies, see Privacy, CA Candidate Privacy, and Brazil Transparency Report.

title: Assistant, Local Content
description:
Local Content is a Brazilian federal policy, enforced by the National Agency of Petroleum, Natural Gas, and Biofuels (ANP), that requires operators involved in field development in Brazil to engage with Brazilian suppliers for local goods and services on projects related to the exploration and development stages. Governed by ANP Resolution No. 19, this requirement is referred toas "Local Content," and is defined as a percentage of the contractual value to be provided by the Brazilian industry.

In order to demonstrate compliance with the contractual Local Content requirements set by ANP, certification of the content is necessary.  For this job, the person performs Local Content Certification activities for Goods, Materials, Labor Services and Set and works closely with Local Content analysts, promoting the measurement/calculation of costs, values ​​and origin of the tax documentation that makes up the scope of the certification work.

What You Will Do:

  • Under direct and indirect supervision, performs work involving conventional practices for Local Content certification, which may include problem solving.
  • Responsible for the assessment of projects designated by the Supervisor or Manager.
  • Completion of ANP spreadsheets, with the consolidation of costs and values ​​determined and Local Content Certificates and Verification Report.
  • Works with the Client on a day-to-day basis, for clarifications, updates and requests for pending issues.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Higher education students or recent graduates in Business, Economics, Accounting or Engineering.
  • Intermediate English preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Needs to be familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Management System. 
  • Excellent organizational skills.
  • Microsoft Excel at Intermediate level.
  • Ability to work well with others.

Reports to the Local Content Supervisor or to the Local Content Manager.

title: UA Manager
description:
Who We Are (Mode Mobile)
Mode Mobile is the creator of EarnOS, a transformational software that turns ordinary smartphones into "EarnPhones." This innovation empowers users globally to monetize everyday mobile activities such as streaming, gaming, shopping, etc. We enable users to profit from their data and attention rather than letting only tech giants benefit. Our inclusive approach sets us apart - converting users into earners and facilitating over $150M in earnings and savings while going a step further and turning earners into owners by awarding stock ownership in Mobile Mobile based on their usage. We have attracted over 40 million users across 170 countries.
Mode Mobile is proud to stand as the #1 Fastest-Growing North American Software Company recognized in Deloitte's 2023 Technology Fast 500 and ranked #2 across all sectors.
For additional insights, check out the information about our reward-based super app, Mode Earn App, which also powers the reward engine behind our proprietary smartphone, Mode Earn Phone.
Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success
Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard-working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.
You can read more about our team and how we work here.
The Role
We're seeking a highly analytical and performance-driven User Acquisition Manager to lead and scale paid acquisition efforts across Mode Mobile's consumer app portfolio. This role will focus on executing and optimizing campaigns across major mobile and web channels to drive efficient, profitable user growth.
The ideal candidate is a data-driven performance marketer with strong mobile UA fundamentals, a test-and-learn mindset, and experience scaling spend while maintaining healthy CAC, ROAS, and LTV metrics across diverse audiences and geographies.
You should bring a blend of:
Hands-on performance buying
Strong analytical rigor and experimentation discipline
Experience working with creative teams and external partners
Solid understanding of mobile growth and monetization mechanics
You'll collaborate closely with Product, Monetization, and Creative teams, as well as Mode Mobile's centralized UA and Growth function, to deliver sustained user and revenue growth across multiple products.
Who You Are and What You'll Do
Plan, launch, and optimize UA campaigns across core paid channels: Meta, Google, TikTok (SRNs/SANs), Programmatic DSPs, Rewarded Ad Networks, and more
Responsible for the daily performance tracking, pacing, and spend efficiency against KPIs (e.g., CPI, CPA, ROAS) of your campaigns
Manage and scale daily spend while maintaining efficient CAC, ROAS, and LTV targets
Run ongoing A/B and multivariate testing across creatives, formats, messaging, and funnels
Analyze campaign performance data to surface insights and optimization opportunities
Partner with creative teams to develop, test, and iterate on high-performing ad concepts
Stay current on UA trends, platform changes, attribution updates, and emerging channels
Contribute to the evolution of Mode's growth playbook, including testing new channels, formats, and markets
This is an individual contributor role managing the UA efforts for the Mode Earn App and other apps, with frequent opportunities for cross-functional collaboration, partnering with product, data analytics, and design to improve funnel performance.
What You Bring to the Team
1-4 years of hands-on mobile UA buying for consumer apps, games, utilities, or subscription products. Ideally, experience with In-app ads monetized products
Proven experience managing Mobile App campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok (SRNs/SANs), Programmatic DSPs, Rewarded Ad Networks, and more
Strong analytical skills fluent in Excel/Sheets and familiar with tools like MixPanel, Google Analytics, Looker, Tableau, Singular (BI Tools & Attribution Frameworks)
Experience with MMPs and performance marketing attribution
Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Monetization, and Creative teams
Strong communication and reporting skills with the ability to clearly articulate insights and recommendations
Bonus: Experience with ASO, web-to-app flows, rewarded traffic, or viral growth strategies
Alignment with our core values:
Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self-discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.
Action-driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.
Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.
Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.
Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.
Why Join Mode Mobile
Be part of a company where the culture is the magic - collaborative, humble, hungry, and invested in each other's success
Make an impact across a global portfolio of consumer apps with meaningful scale
Work with a top-tier, globally distributed engineering and growth team
Help shape and scale high-growth products through their next phases of monetization and expansion
Join a mission-driven culture where ownership is real, ideas move fast, and impact is visible
Grow within a fast-growing company backed by strong leadership and continued investment
Work fully remote with a globally distributed team that values autonomy, trust, and transparency
We Believe in the Following Workplace Norms
Allow OKRs to Guide Us
Assume Positive Intent
Agree to Disagree & Commit
Set New Precedents
Accomplish More with Less
Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards
Speak Up
Be Resourceful
Follow the 80/20 Rule
What We Are Offering
We are a 100% remote-first, global company.
A competitive compensation package.
We offer generous perks & benefits to team members.
Participation in the Company's equity plan (for full-time team members).
We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program.
Work with energetic, passionate, and results-driven people.
Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones.
Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies.
Bonusly - We use Bonusly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment.
Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings).
Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days (for full-time team members).
If we just described you and your perfect role, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to making headway and creating success together

title: pessoa analista de planejamento e dados pleno
description:
AQUI SUA CARREIRA COMEÇA GRANDE.

VENHA SER UMA PESSOA ANALISTA DE PLANEJAMENTO E DADOS PLENO NA YDUQS.

Temos um projeto grandioso e que requer um time com disposição para pensar de forma original, disruptiva, e com objetivo de resolver as grandes questões de hoje na educação: acesso, tecnologia, customização e o sucesso dos nossos alunos.

Somos uma companhia cheia de energia, que já nasceu gigante e com resultados extraordinários.

Venha fazer parte desse time

VENHA TRANSFORMAR VIDAS. INCLUSIVE A SUA.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Os principais desafios como PESSOA ANALISTA DE PLANEJAMENTO E DADOS PLENO são:

  • Desenvolver e manter modelos de forecast para métricas principais (ex.: renovação, inadimplência e churn);
  • Estruturar fluxos de dados, garantindo a limpeza e a consistência entre diferentes fontes, como data lake, ERP e planilhas;
  • Criar visualizações de dados que traduzam números complexos em insights acionáveis para diferentes áreas da empresa;
  • Monitorar o realizado vs. planejado, identificando causas-raiz das variações e sugerindo planos de ação;
  • Automatizar rotinas manuais de extração e cruzamento de informações.

Requisitos e qualificações

Buscamos profissionais com:

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL, com domínio na manipulação de grandes bases de dados (joins, agregações, filtros, subqueries e CTEs);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Power BI, incluindo construção de dashboards dinâmicos e criação de medidas em DAX;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel, aplicado a análises exploratórias, simulações de cenários e desenvolvimento de tabelas dinâmicas complexas;
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados, com capacidade de transformar informações em insights estratégicos para apoio à tomada de decisão.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento ou experiência no setor de educação ou varejo, especialmente em contextos com sazonalidade e projeções de demanda;
  • Conhecimento em Python, aplicado à análise de dados e estatística básica;
  • Conhecimento em lógica de programação, com foco em automação de rotinas e eficiência de processos.

Informações adicionais

Local de Trabalho: Barra Da Tijuca - RJ (Edifício Montreal)

Jornada de trabalho: 40 horas semanais, de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, com opção de flexibilidade das 8h às 17h.

A Yduqs é grupo de serviços em educação e tecnologia e temos o objetivo de promover um salto de qualidade para o ensino superior no Brasil. Oferecemos educação de qualidade para pessoas de todas as classes sociais, em todo o país, e ao longo de toda a sua vida adulta.

  • Analisar dados para decisão de negócio: realizar análises recorrentes sobre portfólio, preços, promoções, comportamento do cliente, etc;

  • Gerir relacionamento com fornecedores: negociar condições comerciais, alinhar planos de marca e acompanhar performance dos parceiros;
  • Desenvolver o time: orientar analistas, revisar análises e disseminar melhores práticas;
  • Reportar resultados à liderança: preparar e apresentar análises e recomendações em fóruns executivos.

Precisamos Que Você Já Tenha

  • Análise de dados (excel, power bi, I.A. etc);

Preferred Qualifications:

CGA is a world-class online school delivering live, real-time learning to ambitious students around the world. With over 1000 students joining us from 65 countries, our vision is to unlock our students' limitless potential, together, for extraordinary futures.

We are doing this by:

title: Manager, Non-Competition Sites
description:
Manager, Non-Competition Sites (Safety & Security)


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The Manager, Non-Competition Sites (Safety & Security) is responsible for planning, coordinating and overseeing safety and security operations across all official non-competition sites for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027. This includes hotels, team base camps, training sites, transport hubs, the International Broadcast Centre (IBC) and other designated locations.

The role ensures that robust physical and staffed security measures are designed and implemented in line with identified risks and FIFA standards. The position leads integrated security planning for team and referee operations outside stadium environments and oversees secure movements between official sites. The Manager provides direct leadership to the Team Security Manager, TSLOs/RSLOs and relevant Venue Safety & Security Managers assigned to non-competition locations, ensuring consistency, compliance and operational excellence across all sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the integrated safety and security planning for all official non-competition sites, including hotels, team base camps, training facilities, transport hubs, the IBC and other designated locations
  • Develop scalable security concepts tailored to diverse site types and operational risk profiles, including transport security considerations
  • Plan and oversee robust physical security systems and infrastructure, including perimeters, access control, asset protection, search and screening operations
  • Plan and oversee staffed safety and security measures, including security guards, stewards and other deployed personnel
  • Lead the planning and implementation of team and referee security protocols at non-competition sites, including oversight of secure movements between sites and stadiums
  • Provide direct line management and leadership to the Team Security Manager, TSLOs/RSLOs and designated Venue Safety & Security Managers, ensuring clear reporting lines and operational accountability
  • Coordinate centrally with host cities, public security agencies and site counterparts to ensure integrated planning and consistent operational delivery
  • Collaborate with relevant domestic agencies and FIFA functions (e.g. medical, venue management, transport) to develop integrated emergency response, contingency and crisis management plans
  • Develop and implement standardised policies and procedures to ensure consistent safety and security operations across all non-competition sites
  • Ensure alignment between safety and security services outlined in rental or contractual agreements and the operational delivery model; establish clear audit and performance monitoring mechanisms
  • Manage relationships with security suppliers, conduct readiness activities and monitor performance against contractual obligations and service levels
  • Oversee invoicing and verification processes for safety and security suppliers in coordination with finance and administrative teams
  • Ensure compliance with statutory and organisational instruments and relevant FIFA regulations, including the FIFA Stadium Safety & Security Regulations (where applicable)

YOUR PROFILE


Education

  • University degree in security management, public safety, event management, law enforcement or a related field
  • Advanced training in protective security, risk management or operational planning is desirable

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in safety and security planning and operational delivery, preferably within major sporting events or multi-site environments
  • Proven experience in leading teams and managing personnel in operational environments
  • Demonstrated experience in secure movement planning, team protection or protective security operations
  • Experience working with public security authorities, private security providers and venue operators in Brazil
  • Experience managing supplier contracts and monitoring service delivery

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong leadership and line management capability, with the ability to guide, motivate and oversee multiple operational managers
  • Excellent stakeholder management and coordination skills across diverse site environments
  • Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to manage complex, dynamic operational environments and make decisions under pressure
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including structured reporting
  • Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (spoken and written) is essential
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

Employment Type

Fixed Term - Full Time

Location

Brazil

Workplace type

Onsite
